# K-mer Test Fixtures

This directory contains test k-mer sequences and data for testing the RustKmer Python API.

## Files

- `basic_kmers.json` - Basic k-mer sequences for testing
- `edge_cases.json` - Edge case k-mers (all A's, all T's, etc.)
- `invalid_sequences.json` - Invalid sequences for error testing
- `canonical_pairs.json` - Canonical k-mer pairs for testing canonical encoding
- `large_dataset.json` - Large k-mer dataset for performance testing
